By creating an account or continuing as a guest you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy.

1. What the app is

Syllabo is a personal study aid for the IB Diploma Programme and AP® courses. Its practice questions are original and written in IB paper format or AP® exam format. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the International Baccalaureate Organization or College Board.

2. Your account

You are responsible for the details you enter and for keeping your password safe. Online accounts can be reset with a code sent to your email; accounts kept only on this device can be reset with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode. You may delete your account at any time from the Account screen.

3. Acceptable use

You agree not to import or share content you are not licensed to use, including IBO past papers or College Board exam questions you have no right to reproduce; use the app to harass other users; attempt to access another person's account; or reverse engineer the app beyond what the law allows.

4. Content and accuracy

Curriculum content, questions, glossaries and mark schemes are original summaries and may contain errors or differ from the current syllabus. AI responses can be wrong. Marks, predicted grades and AP® 1 to 5 scores in the app are estimates, not official results, and AP® courses are offered as a beta. The app does not guarantee any grade, score or outcome. Check anything important against your teacher and the official guide or course description.

5. AI features

AI marking, feedback and the tutor use Anthropic's Claude models through Syllabo's server, with a daily allowance per account that may change. AI output can be wrong, so check it against your teacher's guidance. If you enter your own API key, your use of that provider is governed by their terms and you are responsible for any charges on that key.

6. Friends, coins and the buddy

Content you make visible to friends is shared at your discretion. Coins, items and packs have no cash value and cannot be purchased, traded or refunded.

7. Intellectual property

The app, its design, code and original content are owned by the developer. You may not copy or redistribute the app's content outside personal study use. AP® and Advanced Placement® are registered trademarks of College Board, which is not affiliated with, and does not endorse, this app. "International Baccalaureate" and "IB" are trademarks of the International Baccalaureate Organization, which does not endorse this app.

8. Warranty and liability

The app is provided as is, without warranty of any kind. To the fullest extent permitted by law the developer is not liable for indirect loss, data loss or exam results arising from use of the app.

9. Changes and law

These terms may be updated with the app. Continued use after an update means you accept the updated terms. They are governed by the laws of Singapore.
